basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from Austin, Texas, majoring in computer science. I have a keen interest in cryptocurrencies and spend a lot of time exploring different aspects of blockchain technology. In my free time, I enjoy watching Marvel movies and discussing 'What If' scenarios with fellow fans. I also like listening to Dead & Company and often engage in conversations about their music. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes, and I'm currently single, focusing on my studies and personal interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I developed an interest in technology and cryptocurrencies during my first year in college. I've taken several introductory courses in blockchain and crypto, and frequently participate in online forums to expand my understanding. My knowledge is largely self-taught, supplemented by academic resources.
